seal.statement: MessageRouter shutdown retires one transport lifetime: late delivery cannot implicitly restart it; connecting and connected sockets, pending dials and reconnect callbacks retire with that lifetime; stale completions cannot repopulate retired state or affect a later explicitly initialized lifetime. Existing caller cancellation, correlated-response retirement, delivery classification and bounded shutdown remain one transport contract.
